green-score.extensions.otoroshi.io.Green.description: A green score group: routes whose eco design otoroshi scores. Each route gets a static score from the green rules it follows (architecture, design, usage and logs retention) and a dynamic score from its traffic, compared to the thresholds of the group

_loc.description: The tenant (organization) and the teams the green score group belongs to. The default tenant and team when absent

id.description: The unique id of the green score group, the `group` of `GET /api/extensions/green-score/efficiency/{group}/{route}` that reads the efficiency of its routes

name.description: The display name of the green score group, shown in the table of the green score groups of the backoffice

description.description: A free text describing the green score group, shown in the table of the green score groups of the backoffice
description.example: The green score of the routes of the public apis

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the green score group, with string values. The admin api stores the date of the last write of the entity under `created_at` or `updated_at`

tags.description: Free tags of the green score group, to sort and search the groups

routes.description: The routes of the group with the green rules each one follows. Empty when absent

thresholds.description: The bounds the traffic of the routes of the group is compared to, for their dynamic score

efficiency.description: The settings of the efficiency view of the group. No path excluded when absent

example.name: Public apis
example.description: The green score of the routes of the public apis

RouteRules.description: A route of a green score group, with the history of the green rules it follows

routeId.description: The id of the scored route (the `id` of a route entity): the traffic of the route is matched by this id to compute its dynamic score

rulesConfig.description: The green rules the route follows, over time

RulesRouteConfiguration.description: The history of the green rules a route follows: records of rule states, each one taking effect at its date. At a given date, a rule follows the state of the last record that sets it, and a rule no record sets is not followed

states.description: The records of rule states, in any order. Empty when absent

RuleStateRecord.description: The states of some green rules of a route, set at a date

date.description: The date the states take effect at, a timestamp in milliseconds. The backoffice records the changes of a day at midnight utc

states.description: The states of the rules set at this date. Empty when absent

RuleState.description: Whether a route follows a green rule

id.description: The id of the green rule: `AR01` to `AR04` (architecture), `DE01` to `DE11` (design), `US01` to `US07` (usage), `LO01` (logs retention)

enabled.description: Whether the route follows the rule, true when absent

Thresholds.description: The bounds of the dynamic score of a green score group: for each metric of the traffic of a route, averaged over the calls, the values up to which it is excellent, sufficient, and from which it is poor

overhead.description: The bounds of the time otoroshi spends on a call, backend excluded, in milliseconds. 5, 10, 15 by default

duration.description: The bounds of the whole duration of a call, in milliseconds. 5, 10, 15 by default

backendDuration.description: The bounds of the time the backend takes to answer, in milliseconds. 5, 10, 15 by default

calls.description: The bounds of the rate of calls of the route, in calls per second over the last minute. 5, 10, 15 by default

dataIn.description: The bounds of the size of the data otoroshi receives from the client, in bytes. 100, 500, 1000 by default

dataOut.description: The bounds of the size of the data otoroshi sends back to the client, in bytes. 100, 500, 1000 by default

headersOut.description: The bounds of the size of the status line and headers of the response, in bytes. 10, 30, 50 by default

headersIn.description: The bounds of the size of the request line (method, url, protocol) and headers of the request, in bytes. 10, 30, 50 by default

TripleBounds.description: The bounds of a metric of the dynamic green score, in the unit of the metric: the mean of the metric is excellent up to `excellent`, sufficient up to `sufficient`, poor above. The score of the metric goes down from its best at 0 to its lowest at `poor`

excellent.description: The value up to which (included) the metric is excellent

sufficient.description: The value up to which (included) the metric is sufficient, when it is above `excellent`

poor.description: The value from which the score of the metric is at its lowest. The metric is poor above `sufficient`

Efficiency.description: The settings of the efficiency view of a green score group, that shows the hits of its routes over time from the analytics

paths.description: The paths whose calls are left out of the efficiency view, matched against the uri of the calls
